categories.main_business_segments: SPACE CO., LTD. and its group companies operate primarily in the display business, focusing on the planning, design, supervision, and construction of commercial facilities such as shopping centers, department stores, specialty stores, and restaurants. The business is structured as a single segment, with activities including interior and exterior construction, event and exhibition setups, building construction, maintenance, and consulting/design services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated project management capabilities, covering the entire process from planning and consulting to design, supervision, and construction. Key production methods include individual project-based cost estimation and progress management, with revenue recognized based on the percentage-of-completion method (input method using actual vs. estimated costs). The company emphasizes quality control, compliance with construction laws, and sustainable material usage.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are companies in the retail, food service, and service industries, including operators of shopping malls, supermarkets, convenience stores, specialty retailers (food, apparel, lifestyle goods, books), restaurants, and service providers (medical, financial, educational, entertainment). The company also serves office and entertainment facility operators, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan, with headquarters in Tokyo and regional offices across major Japanese cities (Nagoya, Osaka, Fukuoka, Sapporo, etc.). Internationally, it has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Shanghai, and a newly established subsidiary in Okinawa. Over 90% of sales and assets are in Japan, but the group is expanding its overseas presence, including a planned entry into Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: SPACE operates as a downstream contractor and service provider, directly interfacing with end customers (retailers, facility operators) to deliver turnkey solutions. It manages project execution, coordinates with subcontractors and suppliers for materials and labor, and oversees the entire value chain from concept to completion.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on sustainable management, regional revitalization, and enhancing customer value through innovation in commercial space creation. Key initiatives include promoting the use of sustainable materials, strengthening human capital through education and diversity, IT-driven operational efficiency, and expanding into new geographic markets. There is no traditional R&D activity, but the company invests in process improvement, employee development, and ESG initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based contracts for construction, design, and consulting services. The company recognizes revenue over time based on project progress (percentage-of-completion), with additional income from maintenance, consulting, and occasional product sales. There are no recurring subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese display and commercial facility contractors such as Nomura Co., Ltd. and Tanseisha Co., Ltd. SPACE positions itself as a leading, regionally rooted, customer-responsive provider with a strong domestic presence and growing international operations. The company emphasizes its integrated service model and adaptability to client needs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, consolidated net sales reached 64.2 billion yen (approx. $430 million), with operating profit of 3.48 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 2.55 billion yen. The company has shown robust growth, with sales increasing 21.6% year-on-year and profits rising over 35%. Total assets are 41.0 billion yen, and the company employs 910 people on a consolidated basis.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SPACE differentiates itself through its comprehensive, end-to-end service offering, regional office network, and ability to flexibly respond to diverse client needs. The company emphasizes sustainable and safe space creation, high-quality project management, and strong customer relationships. Its focus on ESG, regional revitalization, and human capital development further enhances its value proposition in the competitive commercial facility construction market.
